378148.name: Emengy Bass
378148.bio: Emengy Bass is a sub label to Emengy based in Vancouver British Columbia, Canada. Our goal has remained the same since founding Emengy Bass in 2014 - To identify and develop talented producers and artists, taking them first to fans and then to the marketplace through new paradigms, creative brand partnerships and front running third party platforms.
